LanguageData.MM_DisruptorStatusTip: Recharges automatically from the light network. Stores up to 8000 light.\nPiloted idle: 1 light/s; moving: 3 light/s; orb: 180 light; caravan travel: 1200 light/day.\nRestores 25 shield points for 250 light. Carries 600 kg; base caravan speed: 30 world tiles/day.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorAttackDesc: Launch a homing orb for 180 light. Range: 30 cells; minimum: 5.5. The orb moves at 8 cells/s, unaffected by terrain slowdowns. For 5 seconds, it deals 40 damage/s with 45% armor penetration to enemies in the surrounding 3×3 cells. It then explodes in a 5-cell radius for 28 damage with 35% armor penetration. Both effects only harm enemies and deal triple damage to buildings. Movement and teleportation are blocked while the orb is active. Recovery afterward: 5 seconds.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorLoadDesc: Choose cargo, then a colonist to load it. Capacity: 600 kg.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorMoveDesc: Move at a base speed of 6 cells/s, affected by terrain. Cannot move while an orb is active.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorTeleportDesc: When no orb is active, teleport with the pilot and all cargo to clear 2×2 ground covered by the light network on the same map. Uses 300 network traffic. Cooldown: about 16.7 seconds.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorStopDesc: Stop current tasks and further manual attacks. An orb already launched keeps tracking and explodes on schedule. Movement remains blocked until it ends.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorAutoFireDesc: While piloted and stationary, automatically launch a homing orb at enemies in range. Manual attacks remain available when disabled. An active orb continues, and movement stays blocked until it ends.
LanguageData.MM_DisruptorLocked: Orb active: cannot move or teleport.
